palette: deep turmeric gold, saffron rail, cream paper, indigo ribbon, seal red wax, umber ink
typography: chess-hall headings on turmeric rail tabs, cream chips and seal red wax verdicts
composition: a chess hall where pie-share and joint-ownership players sit across the board, internal chains run disposal and share-transfer lanes, and the 3:3:4 case forks into house and share verdicts before the joint liability strip
surface: cream paper files, turmeric desk rails, indigo ribbon tags, seal red wax
motion: consent chips travel to a 2/3 or unanimous gate before a disposal may pass, a share chip slides out freely while a priority crown intercepts it at the outward gate, and the case board forks house and share questions into separate verdict lanes
transition: the turmeric hall floor, saffron rails and seal posts persist while the board, chains and forks are re-dressed between scenes
